correctness.rationale: Fixed flags are exactly invariant subfield-linear flags because dimensions are distinct; classical Solomon–Tits gives fixed Euler characteristics and simply connectedness for n>=4. The cyclic subfield-isotropy generator order is rigorously N/Phi_n(q) by lcm and gcd identities, and Armstrong yields pi1=C_{t/gcd(t,L)}. Möbius counts exact field degrees and the reduced Lefschetz trace plus rational coinvariant averaging yields precisely the claimed Betti formula. Independent finite-field enumerations and arithmetic tests agree; these tests do not replace the all-parameter proof.
